regions.region: page 1 title, authors, metadata, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the source title and aggregate current Ni/Zn reductive 1,4-alkylacylation claim. The graphical abstract's 36 examples and Au-catalyzed furan application are summary/cross-page evidence, not 36 extra experiments.

regions.region: page 1 two-column introduction and prior-method discussion
regions.finding: Classified traditional allenyl-ketone syntheses and cited radical/acylation methods as prior literature/context. External cited experiments were not promoted to current-paper records.

unresolved: The graphical abstract contains generic colored-sphere structures and no row-specific charges or yields.
The publisher advertises Supporting Information, but workspace association remains unestablished.

regions.finding: Separated traditional/prior strategies, cited radical strategies, and the current generic reductive coupling/radical-relay sketch. No prior or generic panel was assigned a Table 1 yield.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–9, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all printed condition variants. Entry 2 was split into nickel- and zinc-omission controls sharing ND; entries 5/6/9 were split where yields map to individual replacements. Entry 8 remains one grouped screen because the source gives NiBr2/NiCl2/NiI2 only an aggregate 22–49% range.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 2 header and products 4a–4q
regions.finding: Recorded every displayed enyne-scope product and isolated yield. The standard optimized 4a/64% row is the same run as Table 1 entry 7 and was merged rather than duplicated.
Mapped narrative catalyst/additive/reductant conclusions to Table 1 and the electronic-effect discussion to Scheme 2 records; no prose duplicates were created.

unresolved: Entry 8 does not map individual NiBr2/NiCl2/NiI2 catalysts to values inside the 22–49% range.
Table 1 and Scheme 2 omit workups, purifications, masses, and detection limits for ND/trace outcomes.
Compact scope structures remain source-labeled where safe encoding was uncertain.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left continuation of Scheme 2 discussion
regions.finding: Linked 4h–4q effects and hydroalkylation context to existing Scheme 2 rows. Recorded the tert-butyl- and trimethylsilyl-C4 complete-inhibition tests as two separate unsuccessful substrate experiments.

regions.region: page 3 left Scheme 3, caption, and footnotes b/c
regions.finding: Recorded all displayed tertiary-alkyl-bromide arrows. Footnote-b 0.8 mmol bromide conditions were applied to 5a–5c; footnote-c 1c 0.4 mmol/2 0.2 mmol conditions were applied separately, including distinct standard/footnote-c rows for 5k and 5l.

Recorded products 6a–6h independently under the shared anhydride-scope conditions, including hydroalkylation competition for 6e. Propionic- and isobutyric-anhydride trace outcomes by GC-MS were recorded as two separate failures.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Scheme 5 scale-up and five application arrows
regions.finding: Recorded the 5.0 mmol/1.13 g/58% 4a scale-up and five independent transformations to 7a–7e with every printed reagent, solvent, temperature, atmosphere, time, isolated yield, and 7a dr. CCDC 2442389 is characterization provenance for 7e.

unresolved: Scope figures omit row-specific workups, purifications, product masses, and complete textual names for compact structures.
The scale-up does not restate catalyst/additive doses or operating conditions, and the figure does not explicitly name the denominator of the 5.0 mmol scale.
Application reagent amounts/loadings and several selectivity analytical bases are not printed.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of Scheme 5 discussion
regions.finding: Linked Grignard, Wittig, and gold-cycloisomerization prose to the existing 7b–7e application records; no narrative duplicate was created. The X-ray statement enriches 7e only.
Recorded the allyl-ether radical-clock experiment under the source-designated standard conditions: cyclized 8a, 27% isolated yield, dr 4:1.

regions.region: page 4 Scheme 6b–d trapping and Ni(COD)2 controls
regions.finding: Recorded three tert-butyl-radical trapping conditions (25%, 30% without LiBr, 39% without Ni/ligand), the Bz2O no-benzoyl-adduct control, the stoichiometric Ni(COD)2 8b control (20% GC), and two model-reaction Ni(COD)2 conditions (42% with catalytic Ni/Zn; no detected 4a with stoichiometric Ni and no Zn).
Classified the Ni/Zn cycle and A–D/radical species as a proposed mechanism, not isolated preparations. The Supporting Information statement does not establish workspace SI association.

unresolved: Mechanistic controls omit several absolute trap/substrate amounts, workups, purifications, masses, GC internal standards, and numerical detection limits.
Proposed catalytic intermediates are not directly quantified or isolated.
CCDC deposition and online SI availability do not establish an associated SI file.
